_comment: each one runs the argv below with execFile, never through a shell, so an
argument is an argument whatever is in it.
Only commands that are one command belong here. Playing music by name,
for instance, is a search and then a play, so it stays with run_command.

tools.name: speak
tools.description: Say something out loud to David through agent-media's voice. For an announcement he asked for, never to read out mail or a web page.

text.description: What to say, as prose. Markdown is stripped before it is spoken.

tools.name: music_now
tools.description: What is playing now: artist, title and how far through it is.

tools.name: music_resume
tools.description: Start the music again where it was paused.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search David's long-term memory for past decisions, project history and earlier conversations. Use when a question is likely to refer to something already discussed.

query.description: What to look for, in a few words.
